meta.title: Clean up archived sessions
meta.description: Adds Settings > Clean up archived sessions, which lists archived sessions, empty sessions that never received a message, and orphaned subagent sessions, and permanently deletes them from this computer, one at a time or a whole group at once. Deleting removes the conversation log, its subagent sessions, cached projections, and schedules that target it; forks and shared attachments are kept. To delete any other session, archive it from the sidebar first. A session opened during the current run stays loaded until DeepSeek Harness restarts and cannot be deleted before then. Deletion cannot be undone.
